name: com.sspathare97.fillmycycle
description: Automatically Fill Cycle in Lab Evaluation Sheet on the back side of Index page. To generate filled cycle, enter cycle ranges, eg. Cycle 1: 1 to 5 and Cycle 2: 6 to 10; then for each experiment enter marks out of 100. Alternatively, enter average marks out of 100 for both the cycles.
author: Sagar Pathare
